name: text-reveal
title: Text reveal
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Reveals a short line once, word by word, and shows the plain text if motion is reduced.

meta.descriptionEs: Revela una frase corta palabra por palabra. Con movimiento reducido el texto está visible desde el inicio.

examples.title: Texto que aparece
examples.description: Revela una frase corta palabra por palabra. Con movimiento reducido el texto está visible desde el inicio.

api.name: text
api.description: Copy. A newline starts another line.

api.name: delay
api.description: Seconds before the first word. Default 0.

docs: Adapted from Arc UI (MIT). Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors. Motion is skipped when the reader prefers reduced motion.
